items.title: Python Workers are now generally available
items.blurb: Python Workers allow developers to run Python web frameworks and AI orchestration libraries natively in the Cloudflare Workers runtime.

items.title: Uber Redesigns M3DB Sharding with Subclusters to Limit Failure Impact
items.blurb: Uber has redesigned shard placement in M3DB with fixed size subclusters to limit the impact of node failures, maintenance, and cluster scaling.

items.title: Squalk: an old-school forum engine built on Nostr (NIP-29 groups, NIP-7D threads)
items.blurb: I miss classic forums: slow, asynchronous threads that stay readable and searchable for years, instead of knowledge dissolving into chat scrollback.
